blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 114 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 17, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: HLF & CDW lead 114 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 36 Canadian and 78 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 17, 2026) found 114 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 36 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 16 of them new to the list this week. High Liner Foods Incorporated (HLF) leads with a +91% six-month return, and Consumer Staples is the most represented sector with 6 names.

In the U.S., 78 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 4 of them new to the list this week. CDW Corporation (CDW) leads with a +55% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 20 names.
